name: Inpumon'in no Tayū
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 90); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1210.

poems.title: The fisher’s clothes, though cheap, withstand
poems.author: Inpumon'in no Tayū
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 90
poems.text:
The fisher’s clothes, though cheap, withstand
The drenching they receive;
But see! my floods of tears have blurred
The colours of my sleeve,
As for thy love I grieve.
